name: Qube Browser 0.2.0
notes:
Added:

* Proper split view up to 4 pages at the same time
* Spaces, separate browser profiles but reachable easily
* Mac-mode on Windows, basically another theme
* Library, one place where you can view your downloads, history and more to come

Improved:

* Extension support
* Site permission popups
* Resizing split views
summary: Split view up to 4 pages, Spaces, Mac-mode on Windows, and the Library.
